# The accessory order dialog of menu 249 (AccessorySettingsDlgProc): tri2.x
# moved up (630), renamed (629, 633), and the render split count (635)
# set, then OK (632); a second open moved down and cancelled.
load accessory .\tri.x
load accessory .\tri2.x
save pmm before.pmm
accessory order open
dialog select 628 1
dialog click 630
dialog text 629 renamed.x
dialog click 633
dialog text 635 1
dialog click 632
save pmm ordered.pmm

accessory order open
dialog select 628 0
dialog click 631
dialog text 635 5
dialog cancel
save pmm cancelled.pmm
